cases.name: Amanda Dorine Dean
cases.narrative:
Ohio Attorney General Dave Yost announced that BCI’s investigation determined Reer killed Dean inside their home, cleaned the crime scene and disposed of the evidence.

However, her body has never been found.

Prosecutors revealed that Reer likely cut up Dean’s body, burned it and threw the ashes into a near by creek that were never found.
